scope: Developer fixed visible-information policies; each12seeds×12voyages. Prices and base fuel from approved canonical configuration, no hidden event/RNG peeking, no forced wait, no debt repayment in comparative policies. Ship/upgrade actual costs included; no cargo disposal, declined opportunities not lost inventory. Not phone, optimal play or enjoyment.
